items.name: Power curve analysis
items.criterion: docs/M4_ANALYSIS.json, written by scripts.m4_analysis, is strict JSON of schema 1, confirmatory (no deviations) and of the A7 grid 7d9d53d340006f02 with every cell used (60 of 60) and the grid's design; each arm has a power curve with a point at every premium and a floor whose status is one of reached, below_grid, not_reached; and the gap (PPO's floor minus the fixed-delta seller's) is reported with its kind (point, lower_bound, undefined)
items.evidence: M4_ANALYSIS.json of 2026-11-14, grid 7d9d53d340006f02 (60 of 60 cells, S = 5 x N = 500), analysis code c9d117e0, sweep cells written at 8b47f99d; delta_seller floor 0.0594 vol points (band 0.0324 to 0.165, below_grid, between sweep points 0 and 0.25); ppo floor 0.88 vol points (band 0.174 to --, reached, between sweep points 0.5 and 1); gap (ppo minus delta_seller) point 0.821 vol points (band range 0.00898 to --, sweep points 0.25 to 1); the curve, floor and gap rules were written 2026-10-28, after the sweep of 2026-10-26, and are not pre-registered until A9 (#37)

items.name: Bootstrap validation
items.criterion: on the confirmatory analysis (the power-curve item's), every arm's bootstrap section ran under the rule m4analysis states (section 5.3, #14; written after the sweep and before the analysis read it, to be recorded as A9, #37): at least 10,000 resamples of the seed means at each premium above zero; a level agrees when its reference p-value is at least 0.05 over the arm's levels (Bonferroni), with enough normal replications that the threshold can be reached; every level's agrees flag follows from its p-value; and the rule in force is the t test when every level agrees and the bootstrap rule where any diverges. The item reports which rule is in force per arm; either one passes
items.evidence: 10,000 resamples, 1,000 normal replications, agreement at p >= 0.05 over each arm's levels; delta_seller: all 5 levels agree, the t test is in force; ppo: all 5 levels agree, the t test is in force; the bootstrap rule's own size at S = 5: 0.098 (MC se 0.009) against alpha 0.05

items.name: tau^2 homogeneity test
items.criterion: on the confirmatory analysis, Brown-Forsythe (median-centred Levene) across premiums on seed means was run for every arm twice, on the contrast's seed means at every premium above zero and on the arm's own at every premium, each with its df, p-value and verdict at alpha 0.05 consistent with one another and its per-level split of tau^2 and sigma^2 / N. The item passes on the test having been run and reported, whatever it finds: a rejection is a finding to report (section 5.4), not a failure of the gate
items.evidence: Brown-Forsythe on seed means at alpha 0.05, 5 a group: delta_seller on the contrast W = 0.697, df 4, 20, p = 0.603, not rejected; on the arm W = 0.106, df 5, 24, p = 0.990, not rejected; ppo on the contrast W = 0.431, df 4, 20, p = 0.785, not rejected; on the arm W = 0.696, df 5, 24, p = 0.632, not rejected; at 5 groups of 5 the test's simulated size is 0.003 and its power 0.012/0.052/0.172 at 4/10/25-fold variance, so a non-rejection is weak evidence that tau^2 is constant; at 6 groups of 5 the test's simulated size is 0.003 and its power 0.015/0.062/0.159 at 4/10/25-fold variance, so a non-rejection is weak evidence that tau^2 is constant

items.name: VRP mapping with propagated uncertainty
items.criterion: docs/VRP_MAPPING.json is strict JSON whose source_sha256 is the sha256 docs/DATA_MANIFEST.json records for panel/spx_daily.parquet (the panel build it was read from), with a finite mapped premium inside its interval and a sweep axis equal to the analysis's premiums; and on the confirmatory analysis each arm's power curve is read from its knots by vrp.power_at_noncentrality, through the analysis's own interpolation (noncentrality linear in premium from the anchor at zero, exact noncentral t), at the mapped premium, at both ends of its interval and over it, with the range the curve's band spans over that interval; the sidecar's interpolated curve must be that reading at each of its points. A curve that dips is read as it is; knots that are not a curve are not a pass
items.evidence: VRP_MAPPING.json of 2026-10-28 from panel/spx_daily.parquet sha256 13d63b4e8aaf788e, the build DATA_MANIFEST.json records; mapped premium +0.64 vol points, 95% [-0.344, +1.47], between sweep points 0.5 and 1; delta_seller power 1.000 at the mapped premium, 0.050 to 1.000 at its interval's ends and 0.050 to 1.000 over it (0.050 to 1.000 within the curve's band); ppo power 0.525 at the mapped premium, 0.050 to 0.993 at its interval's ends and 0.050 to 0.993 over it (0.012 to 1.000 within the curve's band); an end outside the curve's grid is held at the curve's end value

items.name: Attribution residual near zero
items.criterion: for every arm of the A7 grid at least one of its cells (a run the grid record under the runs root lists) has an attribution under the attribution root made from its run directory that agrees with its run.json episode by episode (P&L and cost within attribution.PNL_RTOL, the same trades and steps; bit-for-bit reproduction is reported beside it, since a cell attributed on another platform agrees without reproducing); no attribution of a grid cell fails to agree; and every one of them has a residual share (the summed absolute residual over gross mark-to-market) under 5% (section 10.9; the scripted arms measure 1.5% to 2.6%). The evidence states whether vega was exercised: on the flat synthetic surface it is zero and this residual cannot see a vega error
items.evidence: 7 attribution(s) of grid-7d9d53d340006f02.json's 60 cells under ~/VegaLab_Project/attribution (11 readable, 0 refused); delta_seller: 1 cell(s) at premiums 1, residual share at most 1.63% of gross (a9cd378ebf25db26-s100000, largest step residual $846.81), every one agreeing with its run.json (0 of 1 bit for bit); ppo: 6 cell(s) at premiums 0, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, residual share at most 3.34% of gross (8189379004c15610-s100000, largest step residual $63.96), every one agreeing with its run.json (0 of 6 bit for bit); vega is zero on every attributed sweep cell (the synthetic surface does not move), so this residual checks delta, gamma and theta, not vega; vega's sign and units are checked by tests/test_attribution.py on a moving surface; no other attribution under the root exercises vega
